_note: Registration snippet — AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Registration protocol'. Content
agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or
server/lib/rules.php; the integrator applies this and deletes the file.
l3 is a HISTORIA liber with a PROBĀTIŌ (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_l3),
so its numbers mirror the l2 block already in rules.php, not a fabulae
duel: one gentle phase, generous clock, no combat.
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 5 / 50 s; the real
phase is sententia hp 5 / 55 s. bossMinMs 15000 matches the floor the
integrator applied to l2 (a trial must not be beatable by mashing, but
it must not punish a child who reads the sentence either).
quizKey carries three keys per row on purpose, exactly as r03/r04 do:
rules.php stores {q, a} — the question word and the vocab key that must
be picked — so grading never depends on the order the client drew the
options in; `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in
content/historia-l3.js. For a word -> pick-the-image quiz the answer IS
the question word.
l3 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases() (same as l2).
NOTE FOR THE INTEGRATOR: l3 has SIX capitula (h11..h16) but FIVE quiz
questions, as every shipped region does. h15's own cards are all verbs,
so h15 is represented in the sententia phase instead of the quiz; every
capitulum appears in one or the other.
